cards.ex: I can whip up a quick pasta dish if you're hungry.
cards.exUz: Agar och qolsangiz, men tezda makaronli taom tayyorlay olaman.
cards.uzDef: Tezda va osonlik bilan ovqat yoki ichimlik tayyorlash.

cards.ex: The soup was a real dog's dinner; it tasted awful.
cards.exUz: Sho'rva haqiqiy yomon ovqat edi; uning ta'mi dahshatli edi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon tayyorlangan yoki unchalik yoqimli bo'lmagan ovqat.

cards.ex: After complaining about everyone's cooking, John got a taste of his own medicine when his dish was criticized.
cards.exUz: Hamma ovqat pishirishidan shikoyat qilgandan so'ng, Jon o'z taomlari tanqid qilinganida o'z dori ta'mini his qildi.
cards.term: a taste of your own medicine
cards.uzDef: Xuddi o'zingiz qilgan yomon ishni boshqasidan his qilish.

cards.ex: He predicted the restaurant would fail, but he had to eat his words when it became a success.
cards.exUz: U restoran muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashini bashorat qilgan edi, lekin u muvaffaqiyatga erishgach, o'z so'zlarini qaytarib olishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri gapirganingizni tan olishga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: The restaurant's survival is on a knife-edge due to the rising costs.
cards.exUz: O'sib borayotgan xarajatlar tufayli restoranning omon qolishi xavfli vaziyatda.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi noaniq va xavfli vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Hard work and dedication are a recipe for success in the culinary world.
cards.exUz: Qattiq mehnat va fidoyilik - oshpazlik dunyosida muvaffaqiyat retsepti.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga olib keladigan omillar to'plami.

cards.ex: Let's go Dutch on the bill; it's fairer that way.
cards.exUz: Hisobni 'go Dutch' qilaylik; bu adolatliroq.
cards.uzDef: Har bir kishi o'z hissasini to'lashi.

cards.ex: I didn't want to spill the beans about the surprise party, but my sister guessed it anyway.
cards.exUz: Men sirli ziyofat haqida sirni ochishni xohlamadim, lekin singlim baribir taxmin qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sirni yoki maxfiy ma'lumotni oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: You have to take his claims about the health benefits of the diet with a grain of salt.
cards.exUz: Siz uning dietaning sog'liq uchun foydalari haqidagi da'volarini shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak.
cards.term: take with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga to'liq ishonmaslik, shubha bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: I've got a full plate at the moment, so I can't take on any more projects.
cards.exUz: Mening hozir to'la band jadvalim bor, shuning uchun men boshqa loyihalarni qabul qila olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p ishlar yoki vazifalar bilan band bo'lish.

cards.ex: Some people see the food industry as a gravy train, but it's actually very competitive.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilar oziq-ovqat sanoatini oson pul deb bilishadi, lekin aslida u juda raqobatbardosh.
cards.uzDef: Oson va kam mehnat bilan katta foyda olish.

cards.ex: He said he didn't want the job anyway, but I think it's just sour grapes because he didn't get it.
cards.exUz: U ishni baribir xohlamasligini aytdi, lekin menimcha, bu shunchaki ko'rmaganga olish, chunki u olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Eriish qiyin bo'lgan narsani mensimaslik.

cards.ex: After her husband lost his job, she became the breadwinner of the family.
cards.exUz: Eri ishini yo'qotgandan keyin, u oilaning boquvchisiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Oilani moddiy ta'minlaydigan shaxs.

cards.ex: Convincing him to try new foods is a tough nut to crack.
cards.exUz: Uni yangi ovqatlarni tatib ko'rishga ko'ndirish - bu murakkab masala.
cards.uzDef: Yechish qiyin bo'lgan muammo yoki vazifa.

cards.ex: The dinner plans went pear-shaped when the oven broke down.
cards.exUz: Pechka buzilganda, kechki ovqat rejalari buzilib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Rejadagi kabi bo'lmaslik, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: This restaurant only uses the cream of the crop when it comes to ingredients.
cards.exUz: Bu restoran ingredientlarga kelganda faqat eng yaxshi mahsulotlardan foydalanadi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi sifatga ega bo'lgan odamlar yoki narsalar.

cards.ex: Losing the competition was a bitter pill to swallow for the young chef.
cards.exUz: Tanlovda mag'lubiyatga uchrash yosh oshpaz uchun achchiq haqiqat edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan yoqimsiz haqiqat.

cards.ex: With three teenage boys, they're eating us out of house and home!
cards.exUz: Uchta o'spirin o'g'il bilan ular bizni uyimizdagi barcha ovqatni tezda tugatmoqdalar!
cards.term: eat out of house and home
cards.uzDef: O'z uyingizdagi barcha ovqatni tezda tugatmoq.

cards.ex: He's really in the soup now after messing up that important order.
cards.exUz: U muhim buyurtmani buzganidan keyin, u hozir haqiqatan ham muammoga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki noqulay vaziyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: We spent the evening chewing the fat about old times.
cards.exUz: Biz o'sha oqshomni eski davrlar haqida gaplashib o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, norasmiy suhbatlashmoq.

cards.ex: They're like chalk and cheese when it comes to their taste in food.
cards.exUz: Ularning ta'mi oziq-ovqatga kelganda osmon bilan yer.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay farqli odamlar yoki narsalar.

cards.ex: The exam was a piece of cake; I finished it in half the time.
cards.exUz: Imtihon oson ish edi; men uni yarim vaqtda tugatdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Don't put all your eggs in one basket; diversify your investments.
cards.exUz: Hamma tuxumlaringizni bir savatga solmang; investitsiyalaringizni diversifikatsiya qiling.
cards.term: put all eggs in one basket
cards.uzDef: Hamma resurslarni bitta joyga qo'yib, xavfni oshirmoq.

cards.ex: She works long hours to bring home the bacon.
cards.exUz: U pul topish uchun uzoq soatlab ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Pul topmoq, oilani ta'minlamoq.

cards.ex: He had to eat crow after his prediction turned out to be completely wrong.
cards.exUz: Uning bashorati butunlay noto'g'ri bo'lib chiqqanidan keyin, u xato qilganini tan olishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xato qilganingizni tan olish va xijolat chekish.

cards.ex: He's turned into a real couch potato since he retired.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqqanidan beri haqiqiy dangasa odamga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Televizor oldida ko'p vaqt o'tkazadigan dangasa odam.

cards.ex: That plan sounds like a half-baked idea to me; it needs more work.
cards.exUz: Bu reja menga xom fikrga o'xshaydi; unga ko'proq ishlov berish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi o'ylanmagan, puxta rejalashtirilmagan fikr.

cards.ex: I have a lot on my plate right now, so I can't help you with that.
cards.exUz: Mening hozir ko'p ishim bor, shuning uchun men sizga bu borada yordam bera olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p vazifalar va majburiyatlar bilan band bo'lish.

cards.ex: My teenage son eats me out of house every week.
cards.exUz: Mening o'spirin o'g'lim har hafta mening uyimdagi hamma narsani yeb qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Mehmon o'z mehmonlarining ovqat zaxiralarini tugatguncha yemoq.

cards.ex: Despite the pressure, he remained as cool as a cucumber.
cards.exUz: Bosimga qaramay, u xotirjamligicha qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatdan qat'i nazar, juda xotirjam va asabiylashmaydigan.
